purpose: Prepare candidate-independent held-out input roots; no confirmation games authorized by this input protocol alone. Finalist and statistical criterion remain separately prospectively frozen.
exclusions: Entire pinned legal16 source plus all tracked non-BOUNDARY2 positionKeys receipts. Review non-key metadata separately before confirmation. Frozen BOUNDARY2 studies never opened.
selection: 16 legal plies from startpos, nonterminal roots, unique final FEN first four fields, partition1, sorted then seeded sample; no outcome/evaluator filtering.
limits: Book curation and excluding previously used positions define the qualified opening distribution. No assertion of arbitrary-position or longer-clock generality. If insufficient available unique roots, preserve failure; no hidden seed search.
expectedCost: At most120s parsing about75000 PGNs; run only after active match drains, outer600s timeout.
